rule.description: A dependency point (function or method parameter, or non-embedded struct field) whose type is a named in-package interface requires capabilities that package code never exercises on values flowing through that point; the interface's method set exceeds the dependency boundary the point actually consumes.

checks.description: One-shot execution helpers whose parameter was moved from a single-capability interface to the broader shared runner interface, while the helper body still uses only its original capability.
checks.detected_relation: execution-helper parameter -> unexercised capability of a broadened runner interface
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Callers that can only provide the helper's original capability are still forced to satisfy the wider runner surface the helper never uses.

matches.evidence: parameter 'db' of 'ExecWith' requires capabilities [Exec Query] of interface 'squirrel.BaseRunner', but this package only exercises [Exec] on it; unexercised: [Query]
parameter 'db' of 'QueryWith' requires capabilities [Exec Query] of interface 'squirrel.BaseRunner', but this package only exercises [Query] on it; unexercised: [Exec]

checks.description: The three context execution interfaces were each redefined to carry the entire synchronous-plus-context execution surface, so each context helper now requires five capabilities it never exercises.
checks.detected_relation: context-helper parameter -> unexercised execution capabilities required by a homogenized context interface
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: A target that supports exactly one context capability is locked out of the helper that needs precisely that capability, because the interface demands the other five methods too.

matches.evidence: parameter 'db' of 'ExecContextWith' requires capabilities [Exec ExecContext Query QueryContext QueryRow QueryRowContext] of interface 'squirrel.ExecerContext', but this package only exercises [ExecContext] on it; unexercised: [Exec Query QueryContext QueryRow QueryRowContext]

parameter 'db' of 'QueryContextWith' requires capabilities [Exec ExecContext Query QueryContext QueryRow QueryRowContext] of interface 'squirrel.QueryerContext', but this package only exercises [QueryContext] on it; unexercised: [Exec ExecContext Query QueryRow QueryRowContext]

parameter 'db' of 'QueryRowContextWith' requires capabilities [Exec ExecContext Query QueryContext QueryRow QueryRowContext] of interface 'squirrel.QueryRowerContext', but this package only exercises [QueryRowContext] on it; unexercised: [Exec ExecContext Query QueryRow QueryContext]

checks.description: The statement-cache preparation interfaces were collapsed onto the unified SqlRunner surface, so every statement-cache dependency point now requires the full execution surface while the cache only prepares statements.
checks.detected_relation: statement-cache dependency point -> unexercised execution capabilities required by a prepare-only service
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The cache only ever calls Prepare and PrepareContext on its dependency, yet the type system now demands Exec, Query and QueryRow flavors from anything feeding the cache.

matches.evidence: field 'prep' of 'StmtCache' requires capabilities [Exec ExecContext Prepare PrepareContext Query QueryContext QueryRow QueryRowContext] of interface 'squirrel.Preparer', but this package only exercises [Prepare PrepareContext] on it; unexercised: [Exec ExecContext Query QueryContext QueryRow QueryRowContext]

parameter 'prep' of 'NewStmtCache' requires capabilities [Exec ExecContext Prepare PrepareContext Query QueryContext QueryRow QueryRowContext] of interface 'squirrel.PreparerContext', but this package only exercises [Prepare PrepareContext] on it; unexercised: [Exec ExecContext Query QueryContext QueryRow QueryRowContext]

parameter 'prep' of 'NewStmtCacher' requires capabilities [Exec ExecContext Prepare PrepareContext Query QueryContext QueryRow QueryRowContext] of interface 'squirrel.PreparerContext', but this package only exercises [Prepare PrepareContext] on it; unexercised: [Exec ExecContext Query QueryContext QueryRow QueryRowContext]

checks.description: The private placeholder-debug capability was folded into the public PlaceholderFormat interface, so every statement builder data field now requires a debug hook that statement rendering never calls.
checks.detected_relation: builder data field -> unexercised debug capability required by a broadened placeholder interface
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Every PlaceholderFormat implementation, including third-party ones, is forced to grow a debug hook that only one debugging helper needs.

matches.evidence: field 'PlaceholderFormat' of 'selectData' requires capabilities [ReplacePlaceholders debugPlaceholder] of interface 'squirrel.PlaceholderFormat', but this package only exercises [ReplacePlaceholders] on it; unexercised: [debugPlaceholder]

field 'PlaceholderFormat' of 'insertData' requires capabilities [ReplacePlaceholders debugPlaceholder] of interface 'squirrel.PlaceholderFormat', but this package only exercises [ReplacePlaceholders] on it; unexercised: [debugPlaceholder]

field 'PlaceholderFormat' of 'updateData' requires capabilities [ReplacePlaceholders debugPlaceholder] of interface 'squirrel.PlaceholderFormat', but this package only exercises [ReplacePlaceholders] on it; unexercised: [debugPlaceholder]

field 'PlaceholderFormat' of 'deleteData' requires capabilities [ReplacePlaceholders debugPlaceholder] of interface 'squirrel.PlaceholderFormat', but this package only exercises [ReplacePlaceholders] on it; unexercised: [debugPlaceholder]

excluded.reason: Embedded interface fields accept the embedded type's obligations wholesale rather than redeclaring a narrowed dependency; interface segregation treats embedding as a separate relation.

locations: select.go/insert.go/update.go/delete.go/statement.go: builder RunWith(runner) and PlaceholderFormat(f) setter parameters
excluded.reason: These points forward their values into reflection-based external builder storage where later use is not statically visible, so the checker conservatively counts all capabilities as exercised and does not report them.

The wrapper stores the value into an embedded field and returns it as part of a wider facade; capability use behind the facade is not statically visible, so the checker treats every capability as exercised.

locations: select.go/insert.go/update.go/delete.go: []Sqlizer slice fields such as WhereParts, Joins, Columns
excluded.reason: Slice-typed part collections are aggregate storage, not capability obligations declared at a dependency point.
The checker analyzes production code only.
